title: affliction.env_origin_immune
description: M16A § Per-origin immunity short-circuit. Fires once when an M16A env affliction kernel would normally accumulate for `actor_id` but the actor's origin (M17 race) is immune to that kind (multiplier == 0). Examples: robot vs stuffiness, methane_breather vs asphyxiation in O2 atmosphere (where the alt kind fires instead), aqueous vs trench_foot. The `reason` carries the M17 row identifier for the immunity rule.

alt_kind.description: Alternate affliction kind that fires in lieu of the immune kind (e.g. methane_breather sees oxygen toxicity via refrigerant_inhalation kernel).
